headline: LAND BEFORE YOU BUILD (2026-09-15): open PRs hit six while main moved zero times and the lead funnel still reads 0 contacted. The bottleneck is not capacity — sessions keep opening work instead of landing it. HANDOFF's Next queue is now merge-first and nothing else starts until it is drained: #308 (open ralph/* PR, stalls single-flight) then #311 -> #312 -> #313 -> #320 in that order (#320 carries the other three's commits; its diff collapses once they land), plus a read on #316 from another session. Step 2 is CONTACT ONE LEAD: 0 contacted is the computed break, compliance gates the SCALED send but not one manual email to one qualified lead, and 263 sourced / 39 qualified / 3 generated / 2 published are all already proven upstream of it. Also: #322 filed (stage 5 counts a stored preview_url, which does not prove the site still answers); the stale HDS PR template recorded as a wart rather than a sixth issue. || PREVIOUS: /ops/STANDING IS NOW DERIVED, NOT AUTHORED (2026-09-15): Adrian pushed back that chain status should be deterministic. He was right — the hand-written table was wrong three ways: it claimed migration 0007 was unapplied (its columns are live), that generation had never run on a real lead (3 configs exist), and that publish was the break (2 sites are deployed at real Vercel URLs). The live funnel from the leads table: 263 sourced, 249 scored, 39 qualified, 3 generated, 2 published, 0 contacted, 0 replied, 0 won. THE BREAK IS OUTREACH, NOT PUBLISH. Every verdict now derives from two facts — row counts (lib/supabase/leads.mjs leadFunnel) and env-var PRESENCE (booleans only, no values) — via lib/chain/evidence.mjs: a stage is proven only when real leads got through, blocked when it is empty AND names a missing key, ready when it is merely untried, unknown when a column is missing (never collapsed into zero). The break is the first stage nothing reached; the biggest leak is the steepest surviving drop (qualified->generated keeps 8%), tracked separately so a drop to zero does not make the two redundant. Deleted the authored chain.ts. ARCHITECTURE.md is no longer canonical for stage status and now says so. || PREVIOUS: /ops/STANDING IS FLEET-WIDE (2026-09-15): the Standing page now discovers its repo set instead of being told it. GET /api/tasks?fleet=1 reads listOpenIssues() — GitHub's authenticated-identity feed, every open issue in every repo the token can see across hirobius AND adr-eng — then sorts lanes with the pure lib/tasks/fleet.mjs, and pulls every open PR in ONE search call whose owner qualifiers are derived from the issues that came back. A repo joins the view by existing. Verified against live GitHub: 14 open PRs across 6 repos spanning both owners, where the old hardcoded FLEET_REPOS (ops/hds/site-engine) saw three and missed job-hunt, lilac, ralph and every adr-eng repo. Cost is flat in repo count (<=5 issue pages + 1 search), which matters because a per-repo fan-out over a discovered set is unbounded. ?ralph=1 keeps its hardcoded list — the Tasks panel wants exactly those three loops with wedge badges. Handler lives in lib/tasks/fleet-status.mjs so the dev middleware and the Vercel function serve identical payloads; ?fleet=1 is the only one of the two with a dev mirror. Still no new Vercel function. || PREVIOUS: /ops/STANDING SHIPPED (2026-09-15): one-screen fleet read at /ops/standing — the revenue chain (8 links, severed at (4) publish) from a new committed chain.ts, plus three live lanes (waiting-on-Adrian, open Ralph PRs, ready queue) off the existing GET /api/tasks?ralph=1 — no new Vercel function, at the 12 cap. chain.ts is now the third lockstep rendering of the ARCHITECTURE gap-map alongside pipeline-walkthrough.html.
